name: Dowser
tagline: B-cell receptor phylogenetics in the Immcantation framework
summary: An R package in the Immcantation framework that builds lineage trees from BCR sequences, reconstructs germline and intermediate sequences, and tests for B-cell evolution.
capabilities: Multiple tree builders: pratchet, pml, dnapars, dnaml, IgPhyML and RAxML
Discrete trait analysis and measurable-evolution / time-resolved analysis
